The '''Three''' was the main governing body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] and the [[Voss]] species. Their duty was also to oversee the interpretation of the [[Voss Mystics|Mystics]]' [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] and their diffusion; the Three based their executive orders upon the visions' interpretations. The Three were chosen by the Mystics after meditation or according to visions, but had little direct contact with them on a day-to-day basis. Working from the [[Tower of Prophecy]], the Three administered [[Voss-Ka]] and made policy decisions. Depending on the advice of the Mystics, appointment to the Three lasted either a lifetime or just [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. The members during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] were [[Sonn-Vi]], [[Gunta-Mer]], and [[Nen-Ji]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Dark Hollow|Voss}}</ref> By [[3626 BBY]], the three consisted of [[Neeka-Bo]], [[Denan-Mal]], and [[Wila-Ban]].<ref name="Old Wounds">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|[[Voss]]}}</ref>

During the [[Third Galactic War]], the Three reluctantly share with the [[Alliance Commander]] a vision of the Mystics, warning that [[Darth Malgus]] was in the process of awakening an ancient power that would cause untold chaos and that if he were to die, this catastrophe would spread much quicker. Worse than that, the Mystics could not foresee an outcome, other than that the Commander would be the one to decide the fate of all.<ref name="Old Wounds" />
